_note: Every scored survey pair, for the pose-bank convergence campaign. It exists for the reason floor_ladder.json exists: the 14-pair batch that produced the current supplementary was an ad-hoc loop with no tracked list, and reconstructing which chains it used cost a session. Built from the panel candidates in data/survey_*.json, keeping only pairs that carry a scored survey row, and deduplicated on the PDB pair.
_recipe: assembly=None with chains_a/chains_b and labels_a/labels_b renaming both onto 'A' -- identical to floor_ladder.json's recipe, which is what makes the 14 existing pairs comparable with these. All 659 panel candidates carry exactly one chain per side and a null assembly, so the recipe applies without exception.
_rungs_note: 65,536 and not 262,144: the driver renders the whole bank in one vmap, and 262,144 asks for 8 GiB on a 16 GiB card. Pairs that do not converge by 65,536 are CENSORED and reported as lower bounds; they are not extrapolated.
